notice: Made-up demo data. These claims were reviewed by hand against the fictional Lantern Bay packet.

stage_notes.proposed: Described as an idea, a plan or an understanding. Nothing in these records is signed or voted on.
stage_notes.supported: Recommended by staff or backed by a Council vote. Support is not a signed term.
stage_notes.signed: Signed by Harbor Walk Partners only. An agreement signed by the City was not located.
stage_notes.delivered: The packet has no record that homes were built, leased or checked.

claims.quote: The developer has agreed to set aside 12 of the 120 homes as affordable homes.

claims.review_note: Wording differs from the signed letter, which says 80 percent.

claims.review_note: Wording differs from the signed letter, which says 15 years.

claims.quote: Staff recommends that the Council support the request for a 20-year property tax reduction.

claims.review_note: Unsigned draft. Reporting does not appear in the signed letter.

claims.quote: Workforce homes would be for households earning up to 80 percent of area median income.
claims.review_note: Wording differs from the staff summary, which says 60 percent.
